annotations.title: Price on a date or between dates

description: A coin's daily closing price on a UTC day, or its change between two days with the highest and lowest daily close in between, from CryptoKeyhole's price history (Bitcoin from July 2010, Ethereum from August 2015, and the other coins covered). Leave end_date out for the change from start_date to today.

asset.description: Coin code, for example BTC, ETH or SOL.

end_date.description: A UTC day written YYYY-MM-DD. The last day of the span; leave out for today.

start_date.description: A UTC day written YYYY-MM-DD. The day whose close is wanted, or the first day of the span.

name: get_price_history
title: Price on a date or between dates
